chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about the words of Allah, the Mighty and Glorious, 'Or that you touch women,' and he said, 'It means sexual intercourse. But Allah is Covering (al-Satir); He loves covering (private matters), so He did not name it by its specific name as you do.'
ai.seo_question: What does 'touching women' mean in Quran 5:6 according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq clarifies that the phrase 'touching women' in Quran 5:6 specifically denotes sexual intercourse rather than mere physical contact. He attributes this linguistic choice to Allah’s attribute as 'al-Satir' (The Coverer), who loves modesty and prefers to veil explicit details, thereby using a general term to maintain dignity in legal rulings.
